name: Puma Steel
old_description: With decades of experience throughout the Western U.S., Puma Steel provides exceptional fabrication, project management, BIM modeling, engineering services, in-house detailing, design build, and design assist services for structural steel in Colorado, Wyoming, and across the West. At Puma, you will find a dependable partner for your projects, and consistently outstanding service from our engineers, project managers, and quality specialists. Through use of the most advanced equipment and new technologies, we have become the premier provider of structural steel for Colorado, Wyoming, and anywhere our customers need a valued team member.
about:
Puma Steel operates from Cheyenne, Wyoming, providing structural steel fabrication and related services across the Western United States. The company describes itself as having decades of experience in the region, though its exact founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The firm offers a full suite of steel services: structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication, design-build, steel supply, pre-processing, project management, in-house BIM modeling, engineering, detailing, value engineering, erection, and LEED documentation. Its Cheyenne yards hold thousands of tons of inventory, and the company maintains certifications including AISC Certified Fabricator (since 1997), AWS Certified Welding Inspectors, and NDT Level I/II capabilities for liquid penetrant, magnetic particle, and ultrasonic testing. Sophisticated paint coating endorsements (P1, P2, P3) are also available.

Puma Steel works primarily with general contractors on commercial, institutional, and industrial projects. Notable examples include the 1144 Fifteenth office tower in Denver (GC: Hensel Phelps), the Utah Data Center at Camp Williams, the Marian H. Rochelle Gateway Center at the University of Wyoming (GC: Haselden Construction), and healthcare facilities such as Platte Valley Medical Center and Lutheran Medical Center.

The company emphasizes communication as its key differentiator, stating that effective stakeholder coordination sets it apart in the steel industry. Its mission focuses on understanding customer needs and delivering quality products with unmatched values, backed by an award-winning safety program, technical innovation, and strict quality assurance procedures.
